title: Split scans by patient before extracting slices
prompt: Assign every row from a patient to one deterministic train/validation/test split. Shuffle sorted unique patient IDs; floor patient counts for train and validation, remainder test. Return row split labels and patient mapping. Augmented rows must retain their original patient IDs.

resources.title: Cross-validation: group splitters (scikit-learn)
resources.why: GroupKFold keeps all samples from one group on the same side of the split.
